newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Miniature files for 3.7 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Miniature files for 3.7 mln shares.

text.p: Chicago Miniature Lamp Inc said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 3.7 million common shares.

Of the total, 2.7 million shares will be offered by the company and 1.0 milion offered by a selling shareholder, the filing said. After the offering, there will be 18,589,201 common shares outstanding.
The proceeds will be used to repay certain outstanding indebtedness, to finance the purchase and installation of certain manufacturing equipment and for general corporate purposes.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 555,000 additional shares. The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Raymond James & Associates Inc and McDonald & Company Securities Inc.
The Canton, Ma.-based company is a vertically integrated manufacturer and supplier of a wide variety of miniature lighting products.
